title: Cafe for Sale in Bengaluru, India
tagline: Business offer a wide variety of traditional and contemporary food items such as Bengali sweets, Andhra sweets, North India sweets, snacks, and chaat. - The business is not a traditional sweet shop but is designed as a café where customers can relax and enjoy the time they spend. - Based in Bengaluru, our food outlets have become a go-to spot for local food lovers and those looking to explore authentic Indian sweets and snacks. - Business has an impressive customer base of over 100,000+, thanks to our loyalty rewards program that keeps them coming back for more. - The corporate clientele is growing, with around 500+ businesses clients working with us for corporate gifting and bulk orders. - Business generates an average weekly sale of INR 17 lakh (approx. USD 18K), reflecting the popularity and operational success. - The business recently improved operations by revitalizing an underperforming location and opening two corporate outlets this year, driving impressive growth compared to the previous year. - The staff handles daily operations while outsourced maintenance and housekeeping teams take care of the rest, allowing us to focus on serving delicious food. - Overall, we’re all about delivering great taste while building lasting relationships with our customers and partners.
